title: docs site: objectstack.ai becomes the developer site — one-line positioning instead of the duplicated product hero, a "Run it: ObjectOS Community / Cloud / Enterprise" strip, blog posts redirect to www.objectos.ai (maintainer ruling 2026-10-26)
body:
Filing gate ③: a maintainer-directed task. Maintainer (Sam, `os-zhuang`), 2026-10-26: chose 「模型 2：ObjectOS 三版本」 (13:18Z) — ObjectOS is one product in three editions (Community / Cloud / Enterprise), ObjectStack the protocol and SDK; asked 「objectstack.ai 官网和 www.objectos.ai 官网不是很奇怪，区别是什么」 (13:19Z); on the answer (product site vs developer site, one blog, cross-linked navigation) wrote 「同意」 and 「立卡派发」 (13:24Z). Business reason: objectstack.ai and www.objectos.ai open with the same hero and both sell; the developer who lands here needs docs and a start command, the buyer needs the other site. Reader: the devx seat dispatches one dev; file surface `apps/docs/app/[lang]/page.tsx` (the landing), the docs layout's header / footer navigation, `apps/docs/app/[lang]/blog/**` and the site's redirects. Dedupe: issue search "docs site homepage hero objectstack.ai landing developer portal" → 5 hits, none open on this: #17351 (closed: count claims dropped from the homepage), #12239 (closed: homepage), #22240 (closed: compare / when-to-use pages — stay, they are developer content). Session `session_01FMuBZmssbfQkVrKRtxNvng`; siblings: objectstack-ai/www.objectos.ai (the product-site half, filed today), objectstack-ai/objectos#338 (edition model), #26136 (hosted-product name), #26129 (root README).

## Roles, as agreed

www.objectos.ai is the product site (hero, editions, pricing, Build & Ask, blog); objectstack.ai is the developer site (protocol, SDK, CLI, docs, "Build with Claude Code"). Precedent: frappeframework.com beside frappe.io.

## Scope

1. **Landing (`apps/docs/app/[lang]/page.tsx`)**: the hero becomes one line of positioning — "ObjectStack is the open protocol and SDK that ObjectOS is built on: one typed business ontology, and the database, API, Console and MCP tools derive from it." — followed by the start command (`npm create objectstack@latest`), the docs entry points (Getting started · Concepts · Spec · CLI · Build with Claude Code) and the GitHub link. The current sections "The idea / The loop / The gates / The vocabulary" either shrink to a four-link row into the docs pages that carry them, or move into a docs page; the dev proposes which in the PR.
2. **"Run it" strip**: three editions in one row — ObjectOS Community (this repository's runtime image, self-hosted, free), ObjectOS Cloud, ObjectOS Enterprise — linking www.objectos.ai; replaces the footer sentence "Rather build & ask online? Try ObjectOS".
3. **Navigation**: header gets "Product → objectos.ai"; the footer labels the two sites by role.
4. **Blog**: www.objectos.ai becomes the one blog. Posts under `apps/docs/app/[lang]/blog/**` (at least "the-ontology-is-the-software") get permanent redirects to their imported counterparts once the www card lands (`Blocked-by`-style sequencing inside the card: the redirect commit waits for the www PR; the rest does not). Until then the posts stay served.
5. Not in this card: the docs content itself, the README (#26129), positioning copy (unchanged: the slogan and the four-verb line live on in the product site and the README).

## Premises (re-check before dispatch)

- P1 — `grep -c "ontology is the software" apps/docs/app/[lang]/page.tsx` ≥ 1.
- P2 — `ls apps/docs/app/[lang]/blog` lists the posts to redirect; `curl -s https://objectstack.ai/blog/the-ontology-is-the-software -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}'` → 200.
- P3 — the header component has no link to objectos.ai besides the footer sentence (grep `objectos.ai` under `apps/docs`).

## Acceptance

- `pnpm docs:build` green; the landing renders the one-line positioning, the start command, the docs entry points and the "Run it" strip; Lighthouse / link check unchanged.
- No changeset (docs site only).

## 维护者速读

按你 13:24 的「同意」「立卡派发」：objectstack.ai 改成开发者站。首页不再是和 objectos.ai 相同的营销 hero，而是一行定位 + 开始命令 + 文档入口；加一条「运行它：ObjectOS Community / Cloud / Enterprise」指向 objectos.ai；博客文章在 www 那边导入后做跳转。文档内容本身不动。
